suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readxl)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggVennDiagram)
})
options(scipen = 999)
fp <- "inputs/set-membership-111111111111.xlsx"
sheets <- excel_sheets(fp)
cat("sheets:", paste(sheets, collapse = ", "), "\n")
df <- read_excel(fp, sheet = "5 groups")
cat("dim:", dim(df), "\n")
cat("colnames:", paste(colnames(df), collapse = ", "), "\n")
print(head(df, 3))
sets <- lapply(df, function(x) unique(na.omit(as.character(x))))
cat("\nSet sizes:\n")

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readxl)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggVennDiagram)
})
set.seed(42)
fp <- "inputs/set-membership-111111111111.xlsx"
df <- read_excel(fp, sheet = "5 groups")
# Build a named list of unique, non-NA IDs per column
sets <- lapply(df, function(x) unique(na.omit(as.character(x))))
# 5-set proportional Venn diagram (ggVennDiagram supports up to 5 sets)
# label_alpha=0 so set labels stay readable; show_intersections limits text density.
p <- ggVennDiagram(
  sets,
  label_alpha   = 0,
  label_geom    = "label",
  set_color      = c("#4DAF4A", "#377EB8", "#E41A1C", "#984EA3", "#FF7F00"),
  set_size       = 3,
  category_size  = 4,
  show_intersections = TRUE
) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#377EB8") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.1)) +
  labs(
    title    = "Synthetic Venn diagram (5 groups, A–E)",
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "Set sizes: A=%d, B=%d, C=%d, D=%d, E=%d",
      lengths(sets)[1], lengths(sets)[2], lengths(sets)[3],
      lengths(sets)[4], lengths(sets)[5]
    ),
    fill = "Region size"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "grey30")
  )
out_png <- "proportional_venn_5sets.png"
ggsave(out_png, p, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 200, bg = "white")
cat("Saved:", out_png, "size=", file.info(out_png)$size, "bytes\n")
# Also list the pairwise-ish intersection counts (top-level only) for the user
intersect_region <- VennDiagram::get.venn.partitions(sets)
cat("\nVenn region counts (top combinations by count):\n")
print(head(intersect_region[order(-intersect_region$count), c("set", "count")], 15))

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(systemfonts))
all_fonts <- systemfonts::registry_fonts()$family
cat("Total fonts:", length(all_fonts), "\n")
# Look for any CJK-capable font
hits <- unique(grep("cjk|noto|han|sc|chinese|hei|pingfang|wqy|songti|simsun|simhei|microsoft yahei|sarasa",
                    all_fonts, ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE))
cat("CJK candidate fonts:\n")
print(hits)
# Also list first 30 just to see what we have
cat("\nFirst 30 fonts:\n")
print(head(unique(all_fonts), 30))

# Check what font families the quartz device / cairo device can use
fonts_avail <- c("PingFang SC", "Heiti SC", "STHeiti", "Hiragino Sans GB",
                 "Apple LiGothic", "Songti SC", "STSong", "Arial Unicode MS",
                 "Helvetica", "Arial", "Times New Roman")
res <- sapply(fonts_avail, function(f) {
  pdf(file = nullfile())
  on.exit(dev.off(), add = TRUE)
  ok <- tryCatch({ grDevices::postscriptFonts(family = f); TRUE },
                 error = function(e) FALSE)
  ok
})
print(res)
